tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | 5+ yrs Java/Spring & B2B eCommerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years designing, developing and supporting SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) B2B eCommerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and headless OCC APIs, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and production troubleshooting, acting as a techno-functional bridge between business and IT.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – 1836
cover_en.hook: I am excited to contribute to your SAP Commerce Cloud initiatives. With over 5 years delivering B2B eCommerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep Java/Spring expertise with proven headless commerce implementations.

bullets.label: Design & Development
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog and pricing modules.

bullets.label: Headless APIs
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST Web Services for storefront and third-party consumption, enabling headless commerce integrations across multiple channels.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: I created PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, ensuring consistent product data.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: I performed code reviews, led production issue resolution and guided junior developers, maintaining high availability of critical eCommerce services.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026.

tailoring.why_company: Your company’s focus on expanding B2B digital commerce through SAP Commerce Cloud aligns perfectly with my experience delivering scalable, headless solutions for global brands. I am drawn to your commitment to innovative, API-first architectures and see an opportunity to apply my proven integration and performance-tuning skills to accelerate your platform’s time-to-market while ensuring robust, maintainable code.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help your team accelerate B2B commerce growth by applying my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, Java/Spring mastery, and proven integration track record.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering B2B eCommerce at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to bring my Java/Spring and headless API experience to your team. Could we discuss how I can add value?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your SAP Commerce Cloud environment by upgrading to the latest Hybris 2211 release, extending OCC APIs and streamlining PIM-ERP integrations, drawing on my recent successes at Rockwell Automation. My hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and production support will ensure a smooth, high-performance launch of new B2B features.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – 1836
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of B2B eCommerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am impressed by your commitment to API-first, headless commerce and believe my Java/Spring and integration expertise can accelerate your roadmap. I will bring immediate value by enhancing your OCC services and optimizing PIM-ERP data flows. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
